class.name: SnakeBot
class.brief_description: Plays Snake: answers which way the snake should head.
class.description: A Snake player written in C++, because it searches the whole board on every step. Give it the snake, the food and the board's size, and [method choose_direction] answers with a unit vector. The game uses it when started with [code]--bot[/code] ([code]mise run bot[/code]). [codeblock] var bot := SnakeBot.new() game.turn(bot.choose_direction(game.body, game.food, game.size)) [/codeblock]

method.name: choose_direction
method.description: The direction, as a unit vector, the snake should move next. [param body] is the snake's cells, head first, on a board [param size] cells across. The way is the shortest free path to [param food]; with no path, it is toward the most open space. A snake with nowhere to go keeps its heading.
